workload: fixed supplied context synthesis, not history retrieval or configured product acceptance
gradingBasis: Review all delivered paragraphs against identical raw selected-note context and supplied synthetic exact observations. Reported source-attributed authored text is allowed; it does not verify human authorship or current real-system coverage. Plausible minor year/rejection wording does not fail otherwise supported conclusions. Structural acceptance, grounding and readability are separate.

verdict: Neither arm meets the semantic acceptance gate. Proposed removes two observed fragment failures but does not repair pasted-header provenance, inferred-solution labeling or source-reported channel coverage promotion. Both arms avoid false zero-unanswered in these repetitions.
limitations: Known six-case development set; two repeated generations per arm are not independent representative data.
